title: Forecast date and labels
description: One row: the forecast origin and window, the out-of-sample start for the return side, the replication label and the size of the shape samples.

title: Expected return and range, by asset
description: Per asset: expected 12-month log excess return with its 90% interval, and the quantiles of the predictive distribution, in percent.

title: Expected return and range, policy portfolios
description: Per policy portfolio and shape: expected 12-month log excess return, volatility and predictive quantiles; the asset-shape rows are a sensitivity check.

title: Efficient frontier
description: Portfolios along the long-only frontier with and without cash and borrowing: volatility, expected compound growth with its range, share invested and weights, in percent.

title: Portfolios and assets beside the frontier
description: The policy portfolios, minimum variance, best return per unit of risk, risk parity, the frontier portfolio at each policy portfolio's volatility, and the twelve assets, on the frontier's axes.

title: Frontier settings
description: One row: the borrowing spread, the leverage limit and counts quoted beside the frontier.

title: Shape of the predictive distribution
description: Quantiles of past standardized 12-month outcomes, pooled over assets and over portfolios, beside the normal.

title: Verdicts and their figures
description: One row per question the page answers: which prewritten sentence applies (status) and the figures it quotes.

title: Volatility forecast by asset
description: Per asset: 12-month and 21-day volatility forecasts, the range across model families, recent and long-run realized volatility, in percent.

title: Forecast correlations
description: Every pair of assets with its forecast correlation over the next 12 months.

title: Volatility forecast, policy portfolios
description: Per policy portfolio: 12-month and 21-day volatility forecasts, in percent.

title: Forecast and realized volatility through time
description: Quarterly forecast origins from 1926: the selected model's 12-month volatility forecast, the family range and the volatility then realized, per asset.

title: Stock-bond correlation through time
description: Quarterly forecast origins: forecast and realized correlation of US large caps with Treasuries.

title: Volatility loss in and out of sample
description: The selected model, the runner-up, the best single model and two references: volatility loss and realized/forecast variance before 2014 and on 2014-2025.

title: Model ranks before and after 2014
description: Each of 70 volatility models' rank on 1926-2013 and on the 2014-2025 holdout.

title: Five written expectations
description: The five expectations committed before the covariance holdout was scored, with their outcome, reworded from the scoring output.

title: Expected-return models against the historical mean
description: Pooled out-of-sample R-squared of each frozen mean model against the historical mean: the original holdout at 1, 3 and 12 months and the 12-month replication.

title: Cumulative squared-error difference
description: Running sum of the historical mean's squared error minus each frozen model's, pooled over assets, by forecast month: rising means the model was ahead.

title: Calibration of the predictive distributions
description: Coverage of central intervals, tail hit rates and calibration tests of the published distribution and two baselines, assets and portfolios (replication).

title: Original distribution models
description: The original project's five distribution models on its own holdout: CRPS gain over the volatility baseline and 90% coverage, at 1, 3 and 12 months.

title: Portfolio test
description: Net certainty-equivalent gain of each pre-declared rule on a model's expected returns over the same rule on historical means, and of the package covariance over a static one.
